sandbachFocus: Sandbach United host Eccleshall at The Sandbach Community Football Centre in a 3rd v 4th clash on Saturday at 15:00. The hosts arrive on excellent form, unbeaten in their last five games following their most recent draw, while Eccleshall come in on a four-game winning streak of their own. This promises to be a competitive encounter between two of the division's in-form sides.
divisionWide: At the top, leaders AFC Bridgnorth face a tough test away at Brereton Social, while second-placed Stafford Town host Cheadle Heath Nomads at home. Crewe entertain Wednesfield Community in a clash between mid-table sides, with Crewe looking to bounce back from recent struggles. In-form Eccleshall's push continues elsewhere with their trip to Sandbach. Bilston Town travel to Market Drayton Town in a battle involving sides with contrasting recent form—Bilston on a two-game unbeaten run versus Drayton's mixed results. Shawbury United host improving Wolverhampton Casuals; Allscott Heath welcome Alsager Town with the hosts coming off a 7–1 away victory; New Mills travel to Dawley Town; Foley Meir host struggling Widnes Town at Trentham Foods Stadium; and Telford Town face Barnton away. Allscott Heath's impressive recent form, particularly their dominant away win, makes their home fixture notable in the lower reaches of the table.
